subject: Hands-on lab: scheduling, load-test plan and prep packet
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Andrea Park <andrea@northboundhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hands-on lab: scheduling, load-test plan and prep packet

Hi Andrea / team,

Following our discovery call, we want to lock in a 2-hour hands-on lab where we run prompt walkthroughs, routing checks, and a short load test so your engineers can validate latency and KV/cache behavior with your dataset. Proposed objectives: 

- Walk through the prompt sets you shared and agree on routing rules (1 hour)
- Run a short throughput/load sweep with a sample workload (30 min)
- Review quantization/profile recommendations and next steps (15 min)
- Action items and rollout checklist (15 min)

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue Apr 6, 10:00–12:00
- Wed Apr 7, 13:00–15:00

I've attached a short agenda and a load-test checklist to help your infra team prep. Quick asks before we confirm:
1) Who from your side will run the load test (name + access email)?
2) Do we need a whitelist/IP allowlist for the session?
3) Any restricted datasets we should avoid using in the sweep?

Attachments: redwood-hands-on-agenda-v1.pdf, load-test-checklist.xlsx, pre-reads.md

I can send a calendar invite once you confirm a slot.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Andrea Park <andrea@northboundhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: eng-ops@northboundhealth.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 08:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hands-on lab: scheduling, load-test plan and prep packet

Hi Tessa — thanks for the clear plan. Wed Apr 7 would be tight for our leads; can we do Mon Apr 12 09:00–11:00 PT instead? That gives us time to gather the team and vet the sample data.

Answers to your quick asks for now:
1) Load test lead: Rajesh Kumar (rajesh.kumar@northboundhealth.com)
2) Yes, we'll need you to add the Redwood testing IPs to our allowlist; I'll get the security ticket open today.
3) We'll avoid PHI in the test dataset — will send a sanitized CSV.

Also, could you include a short section in the agenda about routing fallbacks (we had a question about multi-variant fallbacks during the demo)?

Appreciate it — Andrea
And on behalf of Northbound Health Eng Ops
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hands-on lab: scheduling, load-test plan and prep packet

Tessa — quick internal note before we lock:

- I'll add a 15-min routing fallback segment and a 10-min prompt review slot to the agenda (slides + sample prompts).
- Ben, can you draft the sample load script and a short checklist for the infra handoff? I put a stub in the Drive folder.
- We should include the quantization tradeoffs doc as an optional pre-read for Andrea's ML lead.

Forwarded for context: (see original)

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Andrea Park <andrea@northboundhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Hands-on lab (Mon Apr 12 09:00–11:00 PT) — prep packet + invite

Andrea — thanks for the quick reply. Mon Apr 12 09:00–11:00 PT works for us. I've created the calendar event and shared the prep packet: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-lab-20270405 and https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-prep-packet

What we added based on your ask:
- Routing fallbacks (15 min) — Marissa will present the canary/fallback policy examples and a simple decision tree.
- Prompt review (20 min) — bring 6 representative prompts; we'll run them live and capture top-k outputs.
- Load test (30 min) — Ben will coordinate the script; Rajesh, please confirm the test runner (JMeter/locust) and the host you'll run it from so we can confirm IPs.

Action items for Northbound before the session:
- Share sanitized CSV for the load sweep (s3 link or Drive)
- Provide public IP(s) for the test runner for allowlisting
- Confirm attendees and their roles (engineer vs product)

Attachments: agenda (redwood-hands-on-agenda-v1.pdf), load-test-checklist.xlsx, optional pre-reads (pre-reads.md)

If anything changes I'll update the event. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Tessa
From: Andrea Park <andrea@northboundhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@northboundhealth.com>, eng-ops@northboundhealth.com
Date: Mon, 4 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confirmed: Hands-on lab (Mon Apr 12 09:00–11:00 PT) — prep packet + invite

Thanks Tessa — confirmed. Quick logistics:
- Rajesh will run the load tests from an EC2 instance in us-west-2 (IP 54.234.87.22) — I'll open the allowlist ticket and include your testing IPs.
- We'll share the sanitized CSV in the Drive folder by Thu Apr 8.
- Attendees: Andrea Park (product), Rajesh Kumar (eng lead), Lila Gomez (security) — please include a short security checklist in the pre-reads.

See you on the 12th.

Andrea
